name: animator
title: Animator
description: Teaches the Assistant to make a cartoon film end to end: script and shot list, character model sheets, elements and voices, keyframes, animation with one cartoon style held across every shot, dialogue, Timeline edit and MP4 export.
author: helmstudio
may_do: Teach the Assistant a cartoon film pipeline, character design and animation craft (text it reads)
Suggest image, video and voice settings as recipes (you still press Generate)
when: Making a cartoon or animated shot, clip or short film: script, shot list, model sheets, keyframes, animation timing, cartoon voices, keeping one style and the characters the same, the edit.

recipes.name: cartoon-sheet-draft
recipes.title: Cartoon model sheet, draft
recipes.note: Turbo (8 fixed steps) for a quick turnaround or expression sheet; make 2 to 4 seeds.

recipes.name: cartoon-sheet
recipes.title: Cartoon model sheet, final
recipes.note: Base, 40 steps: the picked sheet again with the same seed and prompt.

recipes.name: cartoon-sheet-h3
recipes.title: Cartoon model sheet, MiniMax H3 Image
recipes.note: A large, detailed sheet (about 4 MP); up to 16 references as <Picture n>. Heavy: about 39 GB on a Mac.

recipes.name: cartoon-key-draft
recipes.title: Cartoon keyframe, draft
recipes.note: A shot's first frame, 1.75:1 like the 896 x 512 clips; the element images as <image1>, <image2>.

recipes.name: cartoon-key
recipes.title: Cartoon keyframe, final
recipes.note: The picked keyframe again with Base, 40 steps, the same seed.

recipes.name: ltx-animate-2s
recipes.title: LTX Animate, 2 s shot
recipes.note: A quick shot from a keyframe: 49 frames at 24 fps, 896 x 512.

recipes.name: ltx-text-3s
recipes.title: LTX Text to video, 3 s shot
recipes.note: 73 frames at 24 fps. Prefer animating a keyframe: text alone holds a cartoon style less well.

recipes.name: ltx-talk
recipes.title: LTX Audio to video, talking shot
recipes.note: A shot that follows a voice line (up to 13.375 s sets the length); turn No keyframes off (change keyframes.bypass to false), then add the keyframe in Frames at 0 s.

recipes.name: h3-draft-3s
recipes.title: MiniMax H3 Text to video, 3 s draft
recipes.note: A 4-step draft to check the shot before the final (73 frames: H3 lengths are 5 + 17k).

recipes.name: h3-first-last-5s
recipes.title: MiniMax H3 Image to video, 5 s
recipes.note: First and / or last frame (a start and an end keyframe); 124 frames at 24 fps, 20 steps.

recipes.name: h3-references-5s
recipes.title: MiniMax H3 References, 5 s
recipes.note: Keeps a character or place from reference images (<Picture n>); no first or last frame.

recipes.name: cartoon-line
recipes.title: Cartoon voice line, ZONOS3
recipes.note: Bright, lively delivery for one line; pick the character's saved voice.

recipes.name: cartoon-line-qwen
recipes.title: Cartoon voice line, Qwen3-TTS
recipes.note: Lively variation with a preset speaker; lower to 0.3 if it drifts.

recipes.name: cartoon-dialogue
recipes.title: Cartoon dialogue, ZONOS3
recipes.note: A scene's lines with the cast's saved voices; a line's (style) words set its own delivery.
